passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “As for you, son of man, will you judge her? Will you pass judgment on the city of bloodshed? Then confront her with all her abominations and tell her that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘O city who brings her own doom by shedding blood within her walls and making idols to defile herself, you are guilty of the blood you have shed, and you are defiled by the idols you have made. You have brought your days to a close and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations and a mockery to all the lands.
passages.sermon:
The word of the LORD came to me.
God spoke to me directly.
God called me “son of man.”
God told me to judge the city.
God called the city “the city of bloodshed.”
God asked if I would judge her.
God told me to confront the city.
God told me to show her all her abominations.
God told me to speak His words.
God said, “This is what the Lord GOD says.”
God called the city one who sheds blood within her walls.
God said the city brings her own doom.
God said the city makes idols.
God said the city defiles herself with these idols.
God said the city is guilty because of the blood she has shed.
God said the city is defiled by the idols she has made.
God said the city has brought her days to a close.
God said the city has come to the end of her years.
God said, “Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations.”
God said, “I have made you a mockery to all the lands.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֔ם הֲתִשְׁפֹּ֥ט הֲתִשְׁפֹּ֖ט אֶת־ עִ֣יר הַדָּמִ֑ים וְה֣וֹדַעְתָּ֔הּ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבוֹתֶֽיהָ׃ וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה עִ֣יר שֹׁפֶ֥כֶת דָּ֛ם בְּתוֹכָ֖הּ לָב֣וֹא עִתָּ֑הּ וְעָשְׂתָ֧ה גִלּוּלִ֛ים עָלֶ֖יהָ לְטָמְאָֽה׃ בְּדָמֵ֨ךְ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁפַ֜כְתְּ אָשַׁ֗מְתְּ וּבְגִלּוּלַ֤יִךְ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂית֙ טָמֵ֔את וַתַּקְרִ֣יבִי יָמַ֔יִךְ וַתָּב֖וֹא עַד־ שְׁנוֹתָ֑יִךְ עַל־ כֵּ֗ן נְתַתִּ֤יךְ חֶרְפָּה֙ לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְקַלָּסָ֖ה לְכָל־ הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Those near and far will mock you, O infamous city, full of turmoil.
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem is an infamous city.
Jerusalem is full of turmoil.
People who are near will mock Jerusalem.
People who are far away will also mock Jerusalem.
passages.original: הַקְּרֹב֛וֹת וְהָרְחֹק֥וֹת מִמֵּ֖ךְ יִתְקַלְּסוּ־ בָ֑ךְ טְמֵאַ֣ת הַשֵּׁ֔ם רַבַּ֖ת הַמְּהוּמָֽה׃

passages.text: See how every prince of Israel within you has used his power to shed blood.
passages.sermon: Every prince of Israel lives among you.\r\nEach prince uses his own power.\r\nEach prince uses his power to shed blood.
passages.original: הִנֵּה֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֥ישׁ לִזְרֹע֖וֹ הָ֣יוּ בָ֑ךְ לְמַ֖עַן שְׁפָךְ־ דָּֽם׃

passages.text: Father and mother are treated with contempt. Within your walls the foreign resident is exploited, the fatherless and the widow are oppressed.
passages.sermon:
The people in this city treat father and mother with contempt.
They do not honor their parents.
They exploit the foreign resident who lives among them.
They oppress the fatherless.
They oppress the widow.
They do these things within their own city.
passages.original: אָ֤ב וָאֵם֙ הֵקַ֣לּוּ בָ֔ךְ לַגֵּ֛ר עָשׂ֥וּ בַעֹ֖שֶׁק בְּתוֹכֵ֑ךְ יָת֥וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֖ה ה֥וֹנוּ בָֽךְ׃

passages.text: You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God says, “You have despised My holy things.
You have treated My Sabbaths as unholy.
You have not respected what I set apart as sacred.
You have not honored the days I commanded you to keep holy.”
passages.original: קָדָשַׁ֖י בָּזִ֑ית וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י חִלָּֽלְתְּ׃

passages.text: Among you are slanderous men bent on bloodshed; within you are those who eat on the mountain shrines and commit acts of indecency.
passages.sermon:
In your city live men who slander others.
These men want to shed blood.
Some people in your city eat at mountain shrines.
These people commit acts of indecency.
passages.original: אַנְשֵׁ֥י רָכִ֛יל הָ֥יוּ בָ֖ךְ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁפָךְ־ דָּ֑ם וְאֶל־ הֶֽהָרִים֙ אָ֣כְלוּ בָ֔ךְ זִמָּ֖ה עָשׂ֥וּ בְתוֹכֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: In you they have uncovered the nakedness of their fathers; in you they violate women during their menstrual impurity.
passages.sermon:
The people in your midst commit grave sins.
They uncover the nakedness of their fathers.
They violate women during their menstrual impurity.
These actions happen among you.
These acts are shameful and forbidden.
passages.original: עֶרְוַת־ אָ֖ב גִּלָּה־ בָ֑ךְ טְמֵאַ֥ת הַנִּדָּ֖ה עִנּוּ־ בָֽךְ׃

passages.text: One man commits an abomination with his neighbor’s wife; another wickedly defiles his daughter-in-law; and yet another violates his sister, his own father’s daughter.
passages.sermon:
In your midst, men commit great sins.
One man sleeps with his neighbor’s wife.
This is an abomination.
Another man defiles his daughter-in-law with wickedness.
A third man violates his own sister.
She is his father’s daughter.
These things happen among you.
passages.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ׀ אֶת־ אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֗הוּ עָשָׂה֙ תּֽוֹעֵבָ֔ה וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ כַּלָּת֖וֹ טִמֵּ֣א בְזִמָּ֑ה וְאִ֛ישׁ אֶת־ אֲחֹת֥וֹ בַת־ אָבִ֖יו עִנָּה־ בָֽךְ׃

passages.text: In you they take bribes to shed blood. You engage in usury, take excess interest, and extort your neighbors. But Me you have forgotten, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the people in Jerusalem.
People in your city take bribes.
They accept money to kill others.
You lend money with interest.
You demand more than what is fair.
You cheat your neighbors.
You forget Me.
I am the Lord GOD.
passages.original: שֹׁ֥חַד לָֽקְחוּ־ בָ֖ךְ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁפָךְ־ דָּ֑ם נֶ֧שֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּ֣ית לָקַ֗חַתְּ וַתְּבַצְּעִ֤י רֵעַ֙יִךְ֙ בַּעֹ֔שֶׁק וְאֹתִ֣י שָׁכַ֔חַתְּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: Now look, I strike My hands together against your unjust gain and against the blood you have shed in your midst.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Jerusalem.
God sees their unjust gain.
God sees the blood they have shed among themselves.
God strikes His hands together in anger against their unjust gain.
God strikes His hands together in anger against the bloodshed in their midst.
passages.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ הִכֵּ֣יתִי כַפִּ֔י אֶל־ בִּצְעֵ֖ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית וְעַ֨ל־ דָּמֵ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ בְּתוֹכֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: Will your courage endure or your hands be strong in the day I deal with you? I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will act.
passages.sermon:
The Lord speaks to Israel.
The Lord is the one who judges His people.
The Lord asks Israel a question.
He says, “Will your heart remain firm when I act against you?”
He says, “Will your hands be strong in the days when I deal with you?”
The Lord says, “I am the LORD.”
The Lord says, “I have spoken.”
The Lord says, “I will do what I have said.”
passages.original: הֲיַעֲמֹ֤ד לִבֵּךְ֙ אִם־ תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה יָדַ֔יִךְ לַיָּמִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֣ה אוֹתָ֑ךְ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִֽׂיתִי׃

passages.text: I will disperse you among the nations and scatter you throughout the lands; I will purge your uncleanness.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God says, “I will send you out among the nations.
I will scatter you in many lands.
I will remove your uncleanness from you.”
passages.original: וַהֲפִיצוֹתִ֤י אוֹתָךְ֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וְזֵרִיתִ֖יךְ בָּאֲרָצ֑וֹת וַהֲתִמֹּתִ֥י טֻמְאָתֵ֖ךְ מִמֵּֽךְ׃

passages.text: And when you have defiled yourself in the eyes of the nations, then you will know that I am the LORD.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
Israel has defiled itself.
Israel has done this in front of other nations.
Other nations have seen Israel’s defilement.
After this, Israel will know that God is the LORD.
passages.original: וְנִחַ֥לְתְּ בָּ֖ךְ לְעֵינֵ֣י גוֹיִ֑ם וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me. All of them are copper, tin, iron, and lead inside the furnace; they are but the dross of silver.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He said these words to me.
He called me "Son of man."
The house of Israel has become dross to Me.
They are all like dross.
They are like copper.
They are like tin.
They are like iron.
They are like lead.
They are inside the furnace.
They are only the dross of silver.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם הָיוּ־ לִ֥י בֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְסוּג כֻּלָּ֡ם נְ֠חֹשֶׁת וּבְדִ֨יל וּבַרְזֶ֤ל וְעוֹפֶ֙רֶת֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר סִגִ֥ים כֶּ֖סֶף הָיֽוּ׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Because all of you have become dross, behold, I will gather you into Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He addresses the house of Israel.
He says, “All of you have become dross.
Dross is the worthless waste left after refining metal.
Because you are all dross, I will act.
I will gather you together.
I will bring you into Jerusalem.”
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֛עַן הֱי֥וֹת כֻּלְּכֶ֖ם לְסִגִ֑ים לָכֵן֙ הִנְנִ֣י קֹבֵ֣ץ אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶל־ תּ֖וֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Just as one gathers silver, copper, iron, lead, and tin into the furnace to melt with a fiery blast, so I will gather you in My anger and wrath, leave you there, and melt you.
passages.sermon:
The Lord spoke to Ezekiel.
The Lord compared the people of Israel to metal dross.
People gather silver, copper, iron, lead, and tin.
They put these metals into a furnace.
They use fire to melt the metals.
The Lord said He will act in the same way.
The Lord will gather the people of Israel in His anger and wrath.
He will leave them in Jerusalem.
He will melt them there, as metal melts in fire.
passages.original: קְבֻ֣צַת כֶּ֡סֶף וּ֠נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶ֨ל וְעוֹפֶ֤רֶת וּבְדִיל֙ אֶל־ תּ֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר לָפַֽחַת־ עָלָ֥יו אֵ֖שׁ לְהַנְתִּ֑יךְ כֵּ֤ן אֶקְבֹּץ֙ בְּאַפִּ֣י וּבַחֲמָתִ֔י וְהִנַּחְתִּ֥י וְהִתַּכְתִּ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Yes, I will gather you together and blow on you with the fire of My wrath, and you will be melted within the city.
passages.sermon:
The Lord God speaks to the people of Jerusalem.
He says, "I will gather you together inside the city.
I will blow on you with the fire of My anger.
My wrath will burn against you.
You will melt inside the city."
passages.original: וְכִנַּסְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְנָפַחְתִּ֥י עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּאֵ֣שׁ עֶבְרָתִ֑י וְנִתַּכְתֶּ֖ם בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃

passages.text: As silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted within the city. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out My wrath upon you.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking to the people of Jerusalem.
The LORD is holy and just.
The LORD compares the people to silver.
People melt silver inside a furnace.
In the same way, the LORD will melt the people inside the city.
The LORD will do this as an act of judgment.
The LORD will pour out His wrath on them.
The people will know that the LORD has done this.
The people will understand that the LORD has poured out His anger on them.
passages.original: כְּהִתּ֥וּךְ כֶּ֙סֶף֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר כֵּ֖ן תֻּתְּכ֣וּ בְתוֹכָ֑הּ וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה שָׁפַ֥כְתִּי חֲמָתִ֖י עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: And the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, say to her, ‘In the day of indignation, you are a land that has not been cleansed, upon which no rain has fallen.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He gave me a message.
He called me “Son of man.”
He told me to speak to the land.
The LORD said, “You are a land.”
You have not been cleansed.
No rain has fallen on you.
This happens in the day of My anger.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם אֱמָר־ לָ֕הּ אַ֣תְּ אֶ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א מְטֹהָרָ֖ה הִ֑יא לֹ֥א גֻשְׁמָ֖הּ בְּי֥וֹם זָֽעַם׃

passages.text: The conspiracy of the princes in her midst is like a roaring lion tearing its prey. They devour the people, seize the treasures and precious things, and multiply the widows within her.
passages.sermon:
The princes in the city form a conspiracy.
These princes act together in secret.
They are like a roaring lion.
The lion tears its prey apart.
The princes devour the people.
They take treasures and precious things.
They make many women into widows.
They do this within the city.
passages.original: קֶ֤שֶׁר נְבִיאֶ֙יהָ֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ כַּאֲרִ֥י שׁוֹאֵ֖ג טֹ֣רֵֽף טָ֑רֶף נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָכָ֗לוּ חֹ֤סֶן וִיקָר֙ יִקָּ֔חוּ אַלְמְנוֹתֶ֖יהָ הִרְבּ֥וּ בְתוֹכָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Her priests do violence to My law and profane My holy things. They make no distinction between the holy and the common, and they fail to distinguish between the clean and the unclean. They disregard My Sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them.
passages.sermon:
The priests in this land act with violence against God's law.
They treat God's holy things as if they are not holy.
They do not separate what is holy from what is ordinary.
They do not teach the difference between what is clean and what is unclean.
They ignore God's Sabbaths.
Because of this, God is dishonored among them.
passages.original: כֹּהֲנֶ֜יהָ חָמְס֣וּ תוֹרָתִי֮ וַיְחַלְּל֣וּ קָדָשַׁי֒ בֵּֽין־ קֹ֤דֶשׁ לְחֹל֙ לֹ֣א הִבְדִּ֔ילוּ וּבֵין־ הַטָּמֵ֥א לְטָה֖וֹר לֹ֣א הוֹדִ֑יעוּ וּמִשַׁבְּתוֹתַי֙ הֶעְלִ֣ימוּ עֵֽינֵיהֶ֔ם וָאֵחַ֖ל בְּתוֹכָֽם׃

passages.text: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey, shedding blood, and destroying lives for dishonest gain.
passages.sermon:
The officials live among the people.
These officials act like wolves.
Wolves tear apart their prey.
The officials tear apart people in the same way.
They shed blood.
They destroy lives.
They do this to gain dishonest profit.
passages.original: שָׂרֶ֣יהָ בְקִרְבָּ֔הּ כִּזְאֵבִ֖ים טֹ֣רְפֵי טָ֑רֶף לִשְׁפָּךְ־ דָּם֙ לְאַבֵּ֣ד נְפָשׁ֔וֹת לְמַ֖עַן בְּצֹ֥עַ בָּֽצַע׃

passages.text: Her prophets whitewash these deeds by false visions and lying divinations, saying, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ when the LORD has not spoken.
passages.sermon:
The prophets in Jerusalem act falsely.
They cover up evil actions.
They use false visions.
They practice lying divinations.
They say, “This is what the Lord GOD says.”
The LORD has not spoken to them.
passages.original: וּנְבִיאֶ֗יהָ טָח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ תָּפֵ֔ל חֹזִ֣ים שָׁ֔וְא וְקֹסְמִ֥ים לָהֶ֖ם כָּזָ֑ב אֹמְרִ֗ים כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וַֽיהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א דִבֵּֽר׃

passages.text: The people of the land have practiced extortion and committed robbery. They have oppressed the poor and needy and have exploited the foreign resident without justice.
passages.sermon:
The people of the land acted with violence.
They took what did not belong to them.
They robbed others.
They oppressed the poor.
They mistreated those in need.
They took advantage of foreigners.
They did not give justice to the foreigner.
passages.original: עַ֤ם הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ עָ֣שְׁקוּ עֹ֔שֶׁק וְגָזְל֖וּ גָּזֵ֑ל וְעָנִ֤י וְאֶבְיוֹן֙ הוֹנ֔וּ וְאֶת־ הַגֵּ֥ר עָשְׁק֖וּ בְּלֹ֥א מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: I searched for a man among them to repair the wall and stand in the gap before Me on behalf of the land, so that I should not destroy it. But I found no one.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God looked for one man among the people.
God wanted a man to repair the broken wall.
God wanted a man to stand in the gap before Him.
God wanted someone to stand on behalf of the land.
God wanted to find someone so He would not destroy the land.
God did not find anyone.
passages.original: וָאֲבַקֵּ֣שׁ מֵהֶ֡ם אִ֣ישׁ גֹּֽדֵר־ גָּדֵר֩ וְעֹמֵ֨ד בַּפֶּ֧רֶץ לְפָנַ֛י בְּעַ֥ד הָאָ֖רֶץ לְבִלְתִּ֣י שַׁחֲתָ֑הּ וְלֹ֖א מָצָֽאתִי׃

passages.text: So I have poured out My indignation upon them and consumed them with the fire of My fury. I have brought their ways down upon their own heads, declares the Lord GOD.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD spoke.
The Lord GOD became angry with the people of the land.
The people of the land practiced extortion and robbery.
They oppressed the poor and needy.
They exploited the foreign resident without justice.
The Lord GOD poured out His indignation on them.
He consumed them with the fire of His fury.
He brought their own ways down upon their own heads.
The Lord GOD declared this.
passages.original: וָאֶשְׁפֹּ֤ךְ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ זַעְמִ֔י בְּאֵ֥שׁ עֶבְרָתִ֖י כִּלִּיתִ֑ים דַּרְכָּם֙ בְּרֹאשָׁ֣ם נָתַ֔תִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃פ
